verdict.rationale: AvaTax's docs describe assigning tax codes to items (with AI-powered tax code recommendation based on product description/category/UPC) and explicitly support 'product taxability differences' so line items are taxed according to what they are, combined with global jurisdiction coverage (200+ countries) and nexus-aware jurisdiction logic. This covers the core of mapping a catalog to tax categories across jurisdictions, though the evidence doesn't show a full taxonomy list or worked example distinguishing SaaS vs. digital goods vs. services. Missing for 10: explicit enumerated taxability category taxonomy (SaaS/digital/services/physical), independent hands-on validation of correct jurisdiction-specific outcomes for each category type.
